'''''Dominator''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in service in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''Dominator'' was under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Worhven]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ship was used to test the first steps of the [[NOVA]] project. Its [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] were equipped with a new [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] developed by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. The technology was so effective that the ''Dominator'' completely lost control of its probe droids.<ref name="MTL" />
